senses.gloss:
निपतन नि-पत् + अन, n.
 1. Falling, MBh. 8, 1788.
 2. Flying, 1895.

निपातन निपातन, i. e. नि-पत्, Caus., + अन,
 I. adj. Destroying, MBh. 3, 1624.
 II. n.
 1. Dropping, Rām. 6, 74, 24.
 2. Putting on, Suśr. 1, 95, 17.
 3. Touching, 290, 17.
 4. Beating, Man. 11, 208.
 5. Killing, 8, 298.
 6. Flying down, hurrying down, Pañc. ii. d. 57.
 7. Falling down, Yājñ. 1, 145.

निपात निपात, i. e. नि-पत् + अ, m.
 1. Falling, Man. 11, 104.
 2. Casting, 3, 241.
 3. Death, 8, 185.
 4. The opposite extremity, Bhāg. P. 5, 21, 9.
 --Comp.
निपातक निपातक, नि-पत्, Caus., + अक (m. or n.), Sin, MBh. 5, 4053.

निपातिन् निपातिन्, i. e. नि-पत् + इन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Falling down, Vikr. d. 153.
 2. Flying on, Ragh. 9, 40.
 3. Destroying, MBh. 7, 9462.

निपान निपान, i. e. नि-१. पा + अन, n.
 1. Drinking, MBh. 13, 3439.
 2. A pool, Man. 4, 201.
 --Comp.
निपानवन्त् निपान + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Abounding in pools, Ragh. 9, 53.

निपुण निपुण, i. e. probably नि-पुष् + न, adj., f. णा.
 1. Perfect, Man. 5, 61.
 2. Clever, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 490.
 3. Conversant, 57. ˚णम्, adv.
 1. Completely, Rām. 2, 96, 1 Gorr.
 2. Carefully, 4, 44, 82.
 3. In a delicate manner, Śāk. 59, 15.
निपुणतस् निपुण + तस्, adv. Completely, MBh. 12, 10217.

निपुणता निपुण + ता, f.
 1. Cleverness, Bhartṛ. Suppl. 10.
 2. Carefulness, Pañc. 181, 18.

नीप नीप, i. e. नि-अप + अ,
 I. adj. Deep, Kathās. 27, 8.
 II. m.
 1. The Cadamba tree (Nauclea Cadamba).
 2. A proper name, MBh. 2, 333.
